## 描述

Rigid pocket filter for HVAC main stages, catalogued in the pocket-filter category with synthetic-fiber media. The source confirms the synthetic media but publishes no face size, grade, airflow or pressure-drop figure. Rigid pockets maintain their form under airflow, suiting higher-velocity AHU stages. Our advice: confirm the grade and the face dimensions and pocket count against the AHU frame. Request initial pressure-drop and dust-holding capacity for life-cycle cost before bulk ordering.
